choices.epitaph: Broadcasted AWOL combatant coordinates. Received standard ration chit.

quests.trigger: A high-awareness asset offers classified intelligence.
quests.discovery: A survivor maintains a secure perimeter over a sealed courier bag. 'My threat assessment categorizes you as stable,' they state. 'I hold actionable intelligence.'

choices.label: Process intelligence
choices.outcome_text: The data details hostile rotation schedules for the eastern sector. The broker integrates into your logistics network.
choices.epitaph: Processed actionable intelligence. Integrated broker into logistics network.

choices.label: Verify data integrity
choices.outcome_text: You cross-reference the intelligence before acting. The verified portions prove highly valuable.
choices.epitaph: Verified data integrity. Extracted value from confirmed intelligence.

choices.label: Decline transaction
choices.outcome_text: You refuse the operational risk. The broker seals their courier bag and departs.
choices.epitaph: Declined intelligence transaction. Avoided operational risk.

choices.label: Execute forced extraction
choices.outcome_text: You attempt to secure the bag by force. The broker evades, and your ID is flagged on regional hostile lists.
choices.epitaph: Attempted forced extraction of intelligence. Identification flagged regionally.

quests.trigger: An aged combatant performs weapon maintenance and offers data.
quests.discovery: An older unit in degraded military textiles strips a pre-exchange rifle with mechanical precision. 'Your operational posture is flawed,' they state without looking up.

choices.label: Integrate tactical data
choices.outcome_text: You drill urban clearing tactics until nightfall. Their mechanical memory is flawless. They join your movement the next day.
choices.epitaph: Integrated pre-war clearing tactics. Acquired veteran combatant asset.

choices.label: Extract summary data
choices.outcome_text: You accept a rapid briefing on sight alignment and proceed. The combatant correctly assesses you as a short-term asset.
choices.epitaph: Extracted summary tactical briefing. Combatant retained operational independence.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: Your current posture has ensured survival thus far. You decline the overhead of re-training.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed pre-war combatant. Relied on existing operational posture.

choices.label: Challenge competency
choices.outcome_text: You dismiss their methods as obsolete. Their resulting physical demonstration proves otherwise.
choices.epitaph: Challenged veteran competency. Sustained physical correction.

quests.trigger: A high-stress asset seeks immediate concealment from pursuers.
quests.discovery: An unarmed juvenile breaches your perimeter. 'Tracker units are approaching. I am a designated labor asset. Conceal me,' they demand.

choices.label: Execute concealment
choices.outcome_text: You divert the pursuers with false telemetry. The asset departs before dawn, leaving a high-caloric ration on your pack.
choices.epitaph: Executed concealment for pursued asset. Acquired high-caloric ration.

choices.label: Authorize minimal cover
choices.outcome_text: You allow them to utilize your blind spot but deny active misdirection. The pursuers eventually bypass the sector.
choices.epitaph: Authorized passive cover for pursued asset. Sector bypassed by trackers.

choices.label: Deny entry
choices.outcome_text: You refuse to assume their operational debt. They flee into the adjacent ruin. The trackers follow shortly after.
choices.epitaph: Denied entry to pursued asset. Trackers proceeded through sector.

choices.label: Execute apprehension
choices.outcome_text: You detain the asset and transfer custody to the pursuers. The faction logs a bounty credit to your ID.
choices.epitaph: Executed apprehension of pursued asset. Bounty credit logged.

quests.trigger: A non-verbal unit signals an unknown intent.
quests.discovery: A unit tracking parallel to your route maintains visual contact but refuses vocalization. They perform a complex series of hand signals.

choices.label: Mirror signals and observe
choices.outcome_text: You return neutral gestures. They establish a forward scouting position and clear three ambush points over the next transit cycle.
choices.epitaph: Mirrored non-verbal asset signals. Acquired forward scouting capability.

choices.label: Maintain passive observation
choices.outcome_text: You monitor their vector without engagement. They eventually break contact at a major intersection.
choices.epitaph: Maintained passive observation of non-verbal asset. Contact broken cleanly.

choices.label: Bypass aggressively
choices.outcome_text: You increase pace and alter route to lose them. Unknown variables are unacceptable risks.
choices.epitaph: Aggressively bypassed non-verbal asset. Route security maintained.

choices.label: Initiate hostiles
choices.outcome_text: You designate their tracking as hostile intent. They evade your initial volley with extreme efficiency and vanish.
choices.epitaph: Initiated hostiles on non-verbal asset. Target evaded successfully.

quests.trigger: You detect a rhythmic mechanical distress signal.
quests.discovery: Metallic impacts echo from a sealed subterranean vent. The rhythm is mathematical: three strikes, pause, three strikes. It is not environmental.

choices.label: Execute extraction
choices.outcome_text: You expend heavy labor to pry the grate. The trapped asset shares half their subterranean salvage yield in compensation.
choices.epitaph: Executed heavy extraction on subterranean asset. Acquired salvage yield.

choices.label: Confirm presence
choices.outcome_text: You signal back to confirm their coordinates, then mark the location for better-equipped logistics units.
choices.epitaph: Confirmed subterranean presence. Marked coordinates for extraction teams.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You lack the leverage tools. The acoustic pattern fades as you clear the grid.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed subterranean distress signal. Lacked leverage tools.

choices.label: Exploit extraction zone
choices.outcome_text: You establish a sniper blind to ambush whatever rescue team responds to the noise. Your yield is substantial.
choices.epitaph: Exploited extraction zone for ambush. Salvage yield substantial.

quests.trigger: An unknown unit requests temporary acquisition of your primary tool.
quests.discovery: A scavenger requests your prybar. 'A cache is accessible. My unit requires leverage. The statistical return is high,' they state, maintaining eye contact.

choices.label: Authorize transfer
choices.outcome_text: The tool is returned within 48 hours, upgraded with synthetic grips. They also provide coordinates to a secondary, smaller cache.
choices.epitaph: Authorized temporary tool transfer. Tool upgraded. Secondary cache acquired.

choices.label: Transfer secondary tool
choices.outcome_text: You hand over a degraded spare. The unit logs the lack of trust but executes their operation.
choices.epitaph: Transferred secondary degraded tool. Operation executed.

choices.label: Deny request
choices.outcome_text: Your equipment remains on your person. The unit logs the denial and seeks other options.
choices.epitaph: Denied tool transfer request. Equipment security maintained.

choices.label: Track and exploit
choices.outcome_text: You lend the tool, track their vector, and appropriate the entire cache via force. The tool is recovered.
choices.epitaph: Tracked tool transfer. Exploited cache via force. Tool recovered.

quests.trigger: A failing unit attempts a data handoff.
quests.discovery: A unit approaches your perimeter and collapses. They present a sealed polymer envelope. 'Deliver to the Northern Node. Do not break the seal,' they command, before expiring.

choices.label: Execute delivery protocol
choices.outcome_text: You carry the envelope through hostile sectors. The Northern Node processes the intact seal and grants you permanent high-priority access.
choices.epitaph: Executed delivery protocol. Seal intact. Granted high-priority node access.

choices.label: Break seal and deliver
choices.outcome_text: You analyze the data before delivery. The receiving node detects the breach and processes the intel with zero reward.
choices.epitaph: Breached courier seal. Delivered compromised intel. Zero reward acquired.

choices.label: Log as inventory
choices.outcome_text: You pack the envelope. It remains unopened, occupying mass in your inventory without providing utility.
choices.epitaph: Logged courier envelope as inventory. Utility remains zero.

choices.label: Liquidate data
choices.outcome_text: You sell the encrypted envelope to a local data broker. The payout covers three days of rations.
choices.epitaph: Liquidated courier data. Acquired three days caloric rations.

quests.trigger: A micro-asset conducts inefficient salvage operations.
quests.discovery: A pre-adolescent asset with severe caloric deficit is attempting to extract metals from a collapsed concrete slab. Their mechanical efficiency is near zero.

choices.label: Execute joint extraction
choices.outcome_text: You provide caloric support and apply leverage to the slab. The extracted metals are divided. The juvenile transfers a non-functional gear as 'luck.'
choices.epitaph: Executed joint extraction with juvenile forager. Extracted metals divided.

choices.label: Transfer minimal calories
choices.outcome_text: You transfer a low-value ration. The juvenile consumes it without ceasing their inefficient extraction attempt.
choices.epitaph: Transferred minimal calories to juvenile forager. Inefficient extraction continued.

choices.label: Bypass
choices.outcome_text: You inform them the structure is unstable. They ignore the data. You proceed.
choices.epitaph: Bypassed juvenile forager. Unstable structure warning ignored.

choices.label: Requisition extracted assets
choices.outcome_text: You appropriate the minor scrap they have already uncovered. The asset lacks the mass to contest the seizure.
choices.epitaph: Requisitioned extracted assets from juvenile forager. Contest impossible.

quests.trigger: A near-blind elder wants pre-war letters read aloud.
quests.discovery: An old person sits straight-backed with a bundle of pre-war papers tied in twine, eyes gone to milk, their fingers doing the reading along the folds. 'They're letters,' they say. 'I can't see to check them anymore. Read them out, and I'll tell you if we kept them true.'

choices.label: Read them all aloud
choices.outcome_text: You read the whole bundle: love notes, rent receipts, a letter never sent. None of it would sell for a bullet to anyone but them. At the end they sit back and say, 'It's true, then. We kept it right,' like that settles an account.
choices.epitaph: Read an old person's letters aloud, all of them. They said the record held.

choices.label: Read a couple
choices.outcome_text: You read two, enough to prove the bundle is only other people's ordinary lives. They nod, satisfied with the sample, and let you go before the third.
choices.epitaph: Read two of the letters. That was enough for them.

choices.label: Say you don't have the time
choices.outcome_text: You say your hours are spoken for. They take it without argument and retie the twine, slow and exact, the way you pack something that has to last.
choices.epitaph: Told a blind elder I had no time for old letters. They tied the bundle back up.

choices.label: Take the letters for kindling
choices.outcome_text: You take the bundle for what it burns. They cannot stop you and they know it, so they just hold the twine a moment longer than they need to before they let it go.
choices.epitaph: Took a blind elder's letters for kindling. They couldn't stop me, and we both knew it.

quests.trigger: An unverified unit requests thermal sheltering during an extreme weather event.
quests.discovery: A severe pressure drop is imminent. An unknown asset arrives at your perimeter. 'Requesting temporary structural cover. No aggressive intent,' they state.

choices.label: Authorize structural entry
choices.outcome_text: You permit entry. The unit powers down in a corner. At dawn, they have departed, leaving a bundle of dry combustion fuel as payment.
choices.epitaph: Authorized structural entry for refugee. Acquired combustion fuel payment.

choices.label: Authorize perimeter cover
choices.outcome_text: You allow them to utilize the exterior structural overhang. They survive the thermal drop and depart at first light.
choices.epitaph: Authorized perimeter cover for refugee. Thermal drop survived.

choices.label: Deny cover
choices.outcome_text: You secure your perimeter. The unit is forced back into the hazard zone. The probability of their survival is statistically low.
choices.epitaph: Denied cover to environmental refugee. Survival probability low.

choices.label: Execute perimeter defense
choices.outcome_text: You present lethal force to ensure they do not compromise your structure. They retreat into the lethal weather.
choices.epitaph: Executed perimeter defense. Forced refugee into lethal weather.

quests.trigger: You find a dead surveyor with a logbook full of map data.
quests.discovery: The surveyor sits against a wall with their canteen beside them, dry and uncapped, and a logbook open across their knees. The last line is written in a hand going shaky: 'Grid 47 no good. Water gone. If found, get this to my sister, sector nine.'

choices.label: Bury them, keep the logbook
choices.outcome_text: You dig a grave a few steps off the path and tuck the canteen in with them. The logbook goes in your pack. Grid 47 comes off your route tonight, and if you are ever near sector nine you will knock and hand over the book.
choices.epitaph: Buried the surveyor by the path, canteen and all. Took the logbook. If I get near sector nine, their sister gets it.

choices.label: Note the grid, leave them
choices.outcome_text: You copy 'Grid 47 no good' into your own book, strike the grid off your route, and leave the surveyor sitting where they finished their work. The book stays open on their knees.
choices.epitaph: Copied one line off a dead surveyor and struck Grid 47 off my route. Left them with their book open.

choices.label: Tear out the maps
choices.outcome_text: You cut the map plates free of the logbook and leave the written pages behind, names and all. The plates are wrong in places but the ground truth in them is still worth carrying. The book, lighter now, stays on their knees.
choices.epitaph: Cut the map plates out of a dead surveyor's book and left the written pages. I wanted the ground, not the words.

choices.label: Strip them clean
choices.outcome_text: Boots, jacket, pack frame, canteen, logbook, all of it comes with you. The boots are your size and barely broken in. What is left against the wall is only what you cannot use, and the weather will handle that.
choices.epitaph: Stripped the surveyor to the wall. Boots fit like they were measured. Took the sister's page too, not that I'll use it.

quests.trigger: A badly cut scavenger has given up and won't move.
quests.discovery: A man sits in the rubble with both hands pressed into his thigh, blood coming up between his fingers. 'Don't bother,' he says. 'I'm done. Just waiting it out.'

choices.label: Patch the wound
choices.outcome_text: You spend gauze and powder on a stranger. The bleeding slows. In return he tells you which streets on the next block are clear and which are watched.
choices.epitaph: Spent my medkit on a man who said he was done. He paid in directions.

choices.label: Toss them a bandage
choices.outcome_text: You throw a bandage pack into his lap. He starts wrapping his own leg with the patience of someone who has done it before.
choices.epitaph: Threw a bandage to a bleeding man. He did the rest himself.

choices.label: Do as he asks and go
choices.outcome_text: You leave him to it, which is what he asked for. The leg and the cold will settle it between them.
choices.epitaph: Did what a dying man asked, which was nothing.

choices.label: Take his pack
choices.outcome_text: You pull the pack off his shoulder and go through it in front of him. He watches, both hands busy holding himself together, and says nothing.
choices.epitaph: Robbed a man too hurt to stop me. He just watched.

quests.trigger: The line held something large that was someone's working animal once.
quests.discovery: The rad-dog is in the snare and the snare did its work well. There is a worn collar buckle under the matted fur and a notched ear where a training tag used to hang. It weighs more than any catch this month. The broth pot is empty.

choices.label: Butcher it. Meat is meat.
choices.outcome_text: You do the work quickly and do not look at the collar. The shelter eats for four days. Nobody asks what it was.
choices.epitaph: Butchered a collared rad-dog for meat and said nothing.

choices.label: End it clean and bury it with the collar
choices.outcome_text: One blow, then digging. The collar goes in with the animal. The empty pot goes on the table anyway.
choices.epitaph: Gave a working dog a clean end instead of a meal.

choices.label: Log the tag and report the line
choices.outcome_text: You note the tag notch on the wildlife net in case someone out there kept breeding records. The snare is reset. The pot stays empty.
choices.epitaph: Reported a collared catch on the net before clearing it.

quests.trigger: A fowl too contaminated to trust hangs in the bird snare.
quests.discovery: The fowl is fat and wrong — feathers dulled, skin split gray along the breast. The counter says what you already know. Cooked through, it might be food. It might be a slow ledger of doses instead.

choices.label: Cook it through and stretch the ration
choices.outcome_text: Char on the outside, caution on the inside. Most will be fine. Most is a word you lean on.
choices.epitaph: Served questionable fowl to stretch the rations.

choices.label: Burn it and mark the site
choices.outcome_text: The fowl burns quick and greasy. You tie a rag on the snare post so the others know the ground is bad.
choices.epitaph: Burned contaminated fowl and flagged the ground.

choices.label: Save it for the worst week
choices.outcome_text: You wrap it and put it behind the frozen stores. A decision postponed is still a decision.
choices.epitaph: Hid contaminated meat for a desperate day.

quests.trigger: A twitching irradiated squirrel turns up where the meat should be.
quests.discovery: The squirrel is barely a mouthful and it is still moving wrong — too many pauses, like it forgot what fear is. The children would make a pet of it. The stew would never notice it.

choices.label: In the pot. Waste is the real cruelty.
choices.outcome_text: It is done before the water boils. The children get broth and no explanation.
choices.epitaph: Boiled a twitching squirrel rather than waste it.

choices.label: Let the children keep it, doses be damned
choices.outcome_text: The children name it before noon. You will regret the cage, but tonight it is worth hearing them laugh.
choices.epitaph: Gave the children a dying animal to love.
